title: ICCID (Integrated Circuit Card Identifier)
summary: An ICCID is a 19-20 digit number that identifies a SIM card. Format: MMCC (2 digits, Major Industry Identifier, 89 for telecom) + II (2-3 digits, Country Code) + NN (variable, Issuer Identifier) + AAA... (variable, Individual Account) + C (1 digit, Check digit, Luhn).

notes: Account ID: variable length (up to 12 digits).
ICCID is printed on the SIM card and stored in the SIM's EF (Elementary File).
